card.name: Verbs in biographies of people
card.fires_on: The word right after a named person's subject in a biography, usually a verb like was, worked, served or might, or a word such as a or in. It appears where the text goes on to tell what that person became or did.

modes.label: Life-story verb
modes.description: A verb after a person's name or description that starts a fact about their career or life.
modes.example: Egonu, for Uzo Egonu (1931-1996), a Nigerian-born painter who at 13<< was>> sent to England to study art, first

modes.label: Career or award link
modes.description: A small word leading into an award, role, or service record.
modes.example: British biologist Peter Medawar had an illustrious career, winning<< a>> Nobel Prize in 1960

modes.label: Illness or death of a person
modes.description: A linking word before a diagnosis or a death detail about a named person.
modes.example: Women Will Learn That They<< Have>> Ovarian Cancer This Year FORMAT
